name: BRAND TEXT
description:
After many years in business Master Sauna have had to shut their doors but Infrared Sauna Parts and delighted to stock spare parts for this brand and offer specific repair advice for their models.



Master Sauna provided thousands of infrared sauna cabins to satisfied customers over the years it was in business. Master Sauna focused on infrared saunas and heating systems that would provide the best and most efficient pain relief both for clinical ailments and strains from regular exercise. In fact, customers without long term ailments were encouraged to complete some light to moderate exercise before relaxing in a Master Sauna to gain the full health benefits of the sauna cabin.



Furthermore, they are available in space saving designs or more elegant larger models which can fit up to 4 or 5 individuals. The Master Sauna Brand is so confident in the health benefits that can be gained from regular use of their infrared saunas they always encouraged customers to invite friends over for a traditional sauna style party to experience the possibilities themselves. With advanced heaters, simple control panels and high quality speaker systems, Master Sauna’s product range is second to none. Sit back, relax and personalise your heath goals while using this infrared technology.
